# InstaLabel

> InstaLabel is kitchen labelling software for food businesses. Staff keep item, ingredient, allergen and date information in one place and print labels from the web app or the Android app.

The current public promotion is the Christmas offer. It is for new customers only and ends on 10 January 2027.

- New customers receive 60 days free.
- An annual plan also receives 30% off the first annual payment. The following renewal is the full price.
- A monthly plan receives the 60 days, then the normal monthly price. The 30% does not apply to monthly billing.
- Payment details are collected at checkout. There is no charge during the free period. The subscription can be cancelled at any time.
- The customer-facing code, when one is active, is shown on the Christmas offer page. Someone who has already had a subscription cannot use the offer.

## Offer

- [Christmas offer](https://www.instalabel.co/christmas): 60 days free for new customers, plus 30% off the first annual payment. Ends 10 January 2027.
